# Security Checklist: Catálogo de leitura (reading-catalog)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de segurança da 005 (leitura só por propriedades, catálogo sem dados da conta nem do jogo, análise offline, peça desconhecida) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## Leitura no jogo em execução

- [x] CHK001 Is property-only reading stated for the slices organized by content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK002 Is it stated that nothing stays resident in the game's page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK003 Are calling a game function, writing to the save and automating clicks excluded in the running game? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK004 Is the limit on reads per second stated, with no two in flight? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK005 Is the closed list of `_vars` kept when the catalog inventories them? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005]

## Catálogo e artefatos

- [x] CHK006 Are account values, player names and excerpts of the game's file excluded from the catalog? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is it stated that character names, which are keys of the state, do not enter the catalog? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK008 Are the real states used in the analysis kept out of the repository? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 Is the content of the diagnostic log of the scripted session limited? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Análise offline

- [x] CHK010 Is running the game's code limited to the offline copy, isolated and with no network? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK011 Is every analysis step other than the scripted session kept away from the running game? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK012 Is network access excluded outside the app's updater? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Peça desconhecida

- [x] CHK013 Is the behavior defined for a piece the catalog does not know? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK014 Is it stated that no piece stops being read? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK005 e CHK009: respondidos por padrões do agente, na tabela Open Questions.
